classification.resume: This is a video recording of a parliamentary question session from the National Council (Nationalrat) in Switzerland, featuring Marcel Scherer and Johann N. Schneider-Ammann discussing the hygienization of kitchen and food waste before energy recovery. The session took place on 7 March 2011 during the spring session of the 2011 legislative period. The record is part of the parliamentary protocols and video archives.
